definitions.content: group of load cells which for the purposes of type evaluation are considered as one family and that are of the same material or combination of materials, the same design of the measurement technique, the same principle used to attach the strain gauge to the load cell, the same method of construction, the same set of specifications, and one or more load cell groups where all load cells within the group possess identical metrological characteristics

notes.content: The examples provided are not intended to be limiting.

definitions.content: groupe de cellules de pesée qui, pour les besoins de l'évaluation de type, sont considérées comme une famille
